name: Zanjibaru
source:
The city is filled with monsters. During night, the darkness takes shape and bares its fangs. The voice of evil God asleep in the deep ground stimulates the monsters. Yae, who is a monster buster, gets involved in this epic and sad battle....

[From ErogeShop]
